Name: PFM-Flower Jelly for Upgraded Jars
Author: zyh2077
Description:
Now you can make flower jelly. Very simple PFM Mod!
This mod literally turns '[i]all[/i]' flowers into jelly. [i]P[/i][i]oisonous flowers[/i] can also be used as ingredients.
Use this mod. 
Now you can use the jars in "CP Upgraded Jars" to make jelly.
